name: newspaper
description: A full-stack newspaper-style web app aggregating live news, stock market data, and weather using Next.js, TypeScript, and MongoDB.

paragraphs: A full-stack news site that answers questions about the day's stories, with cited sources, alongside weather forecasts and market data. Built with Next.js 16, TypeScript, MongoDB, Pinecone and Claude, tested in CI with Vitest and Playwright, and monitored with Datadog.
features: One box for search and questions. Typing shows up to five matching headlines; Enter asks the question.

Answers cite their sources. Claude answers only from the retrieved articles' headlines and summaries, using search-result citations. Every citation is checked in code against the articles actually sent, and each number…

Related stories by meaning. The articles nearest the question (Pinecone, llama-text-embed-v2) replace the grid under the answer, cut at a match score measured on a labelled set (see Measured, not guessed).
Bounded cost. Ten questions per IP an hour and 200 a day site-wide, counted in MongoDB before any paid call. When Ask is unavailable or over the limit, the box falls back to keyword search.
Headlines from The New York Times and the BBC, via their public RSS feeds: no API keys, no rate limits
